# Demo B composes its native-window host routing

## Context

One-PR continuation of #15614, following the [current ownership map](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/15614#issuecomment-6693132722). Staging, gesture execution and keyboard policy have separate hosts; native source callbacks and reservation/bind/release routing still occupy the same large composition class.

## The Problem

`examples/dashboard/crossWindow/DemoBWorkspace.mjs` mixes native-window flow translation with document composition. Registration alone would leave half the same key/flow boundary behind: the Group owns tear-out admission, while the host routes stage and click-popout reservations. Extract these together, including lease expiration, without creating another state owner.

## The Architectural Reality

At `a903ef6d8d0c10d32cc0b4c1d725e61ec16a1a46`:
- `DemoBWorkspace:1881–2227` contains the six methods; `getPlacementHints` inside that span belongs to the host and stays.
- `src/manager/transaction/NativeLifecycle.mjs:75–98` owns sources and their admissions, connections, owners and retirements. Unregistering withdraws effects and retains Group records.
- `DemoBKeyboardHost.mjs` establishes a registered Base prototype mixin: no second instance or lifecycle; methods use the workspace's current fields and facades.
- `adoptTopologyGroup` registers three documents. Construction, fields, TransactionManager listener installation/removal and destruction remain host-owned. Both source withdrawals precede listener/collaborator teardown.

Design authority: n/a — behavior-preserving decomposition of the accepted parent; no existing native behavior is declared wrong.

Prescription checked: `examples/dashboard/crossWindow/DemoBWorkspace.mjs` and sibling `DemoBKeyboardHost.mjs` — demo-local composition owns the concern. Euclid's independent source read favors one native adapter/routing leaf; moving policy to the engine or introducing another lifecycle would duplicate authority.

## The Fix

Add `examples/dashboard/crossWindow/DemoBNativeWindowHost.mjs`, a Base mixin, and compose it into DemoBWorkspace. Move `bindNativeWindowSources`, `reserveVessel`, `revokeVessel`, `onTopologyLeaseExpired`, `onTopologyBind`, and release-routing implementation. Retain `onTopologyRelease(data)` as a workspace facade supplying its three semantic workspace constants to `routeTopologyRelease`; do not import the workspace back into its mixin.

Preserve the injectable manager in source registration, return values/promises, two key shapes, stage source's refusing `open`, post-await identity/retirement checks, per-admission `context.staged`, and current `this.*` collaborator/facade lookup. No new independently owned fields, listeners or lifecycle instance.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Source registration and effects | DemoBWorkspace:1881; NativeLifecycle:75–98 | Same vessel `popup:<itemId>` and stage workspace-key adapters; Group records survive host teardown | Existing refusal/retirement paths | Mixin JSDoc | Both-source retention plus connect-first/terminal-first controls |
| Reservation, lease and bind methods | DemoBWorkspace:2012–2120 | Same host methods and exact reservation fences; current mount/collaborator after waits | Existing null/refusal/no-publication results | Method JSDoc | Deferred geometry/stage, revoke/replacement/destroy controls |
| `onTopologyRelease(data)` | DemoBWorkspace:2134–2227 | Same signature/settlement; host constants passed to routing mixin | Existing reattach/cancel outcomes | Facade + routing JSDoc | One popup closes while sibling/main participation survives |

Decision Record impact: aligned-with `neomjs/neo#adr:docking-design` §2.3 (per-host stage composition).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Six-method boundary extracted; public host entry points and return values retained. Host still owns document registration, fields, listeners and destruction order; no new state owner.
- [ ] Existing DemoBWorkspace/TourRunner tests pass without weakened expectations, including both adoption orders, reservation expiry, retained Group records and sibling-popup survival.
- [ ] Deterministic controls prove current facades/collaborators are observed after awaited geometry, and revoked/replaced reservations or destruction cannot publish late. Hold a real stage render update through destruction to verify settlement refuses without reviving effects.
- [ ] Full Engine unit suite and affected headed cross-window drag, keyboard detach, vessel conversion, perspectives, tear-out and third-claimant E2E witnesses pass. Record exact run scope and runtime source separately from installed acceptance.
- [ ] New class and moved methods retain contextual JSDoc/`@summary`; parent map records this slice while leaving remaining host size and final matrix acceptance open.

## Out of Scope

Workspace superclass changes; TopologyLibrary or persistence extraction; engine protocol/Group ownership changes; park/re-show transaction policy; new native-window behavior; claiming the parent's ≤1500-line/final matrix outcome complete.

## Avoided Traps

A registration-only shell leaves routing scattered. A constructed helper duplicates lifetime ownership. Cached bound callbacks or copied collaborators lose current host overrides. Clearing Group records at teardown reverses the shipped ownership migration. Lease expiry only deletes the existing pending host reservation; it must not gain closure, Group revocation or pane-return responsibilities.
